$reason: An `aria-hidden` on an `<ng-content>`, whose own content Angular draws when nothing is projected: the option and a comment inside the `list`, the attribute reaching no element (measured, Angular 22.2), so the option is in the tree under the `list`. The tree holds the tag as a projection named `ng-content`, whatever its case or namespace. A walk that did not count a projection among Angular's own tags read it as an element that hides and passed the option.
